Hi, I’m Stefan Mihai, a product designer.

I design complex B2B and regulated products: maritime SaaS, healthtech and mental wellbeing. Right now I’m designing AI-assisted tools for the maritime industry. Based in Romania, working remotely with teams in the EU and the US.

About

| Craft × Clarity |
I started in graphic design and moved into product design, so I care about both craft and clarity.

I work from early discovery to high-fidelity UI: research with clients and domain experts, competitive analysis, heuristic reviews, usability testing, information architecture, prototypes and developer handoff.

Lately I focus on AI-assisted products: designing for long waits, partial failures and moments where the AI proposes and people decide. I work closely with clients, product managers and developers to get there.

Beyond the screen

I’m passionate about sports and I’ve been skateboarding for more than 13 years. I love nature and spending time outdoors, and I’m always keen to explore and try new things, a mindset I bring into my design work too.
